fontes.titulo: The five deeps: the location and depth of the deepest place in each of the world's oceans
fontes.autor_ou_orgao: Heather A. Stewart; Alan J. Jamieson (Earth-Science Reviews 197:102896, DOI 10.1016/j.earscirev.2019.102896)
